nodes.label: Config validation error reporting and safe mode fallback
nodes.rationale: On a pydantic ValidationError the raw YAML is reloaded with ruamel round-trip parsing purely to walk the error loc path and recover line numbers, since pydantic errors carry no source position. Rather than exiting, Frigate retries FrigateConfig.load(safe_load=True) so the UI comes up in safe mode and the user can fix the config from the web interface instead of the filesystem.

nodes.label: Forkserver start method with module preload
nodes.rationale: Frigate forces the forkserver start method and preloads sqlite3, numpy, cv2, peewee, zmq, ruamel.yaml, and frigate.camera.maintainer into the server process. Forkserver avoids inheriting the parent's threads and locks (which fork would deadlock on), while preloading the heavy imports once amortizes import cost across every camera process spawned later.
